notes: Contagious Zombie (vanilla zombie variant with red glowing eyes). chance: natural spawn outside cities; cityChance: inside Lost Cities; cap: at most capCount within capRadius blocks; any hit on an uninfected player applies hordes:infected for infectionTicks. parasiteChance: on death, chance to burst into Zombie Extreme parasites (parasiteMin..parasiteMax, even odds). deepChance/deepY/deepCapCount (13/11/2026): below deepY (the deepslate) and above the bedrock, a new common zombie becomes Contagious with deepChance, up to deepCapCount within capRadius.
